description: This file contains functions for parsing process information from the Linux /proc filesystem, particularly focusing on reading process parent-child relationships and associated process names, as well as collecting process information for tracing purposes.

methods.name: int parse_proc_stat(struct strbuf * sb,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Parses the contents of /proc/[pid]/stat to extract the process name and parent pid, handling complex process names that may contain special characters.

methods.name: int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Reads and parses the /proc/[pid]/stat file to retrieve the parent process ID and name.

methods.name: void push_ancestry_name(struct strvec * names,pid_t pid)
methods.description: Recursively gathers the ancestry of process names starting from a given pid.

methods.name: void trace2_collect_process_info(enum trace2_process_info_reason reason)
methods.description: Public function that collects and traces process ancestry information based on the provided reason (start-up or exit).

ctags.name: stat_parent_pid
ctags.pattern: /^static int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid, struct strbuf *name, int *statppid)$/
